source_notes: Exact venue IDs, names and cities from authorized API-Football league 5 snapshots (2022/2024/2026), observed 2026-09-24. Association geography mapped explicitly; not inferred from nominal home team.

Venue-country classification is conditional on provider venue metadata. This is not proof that every historical venue was independently verified. Missing/unrecognized venues are excluded or marked unsupported, never imputed as home.
England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland are separate football associations. No automatic new-city or new-team guessing.

Spot checks against UEFA official matchinfo and official finals hosts confirm selected relocated/neutral fixtures. Neutral means third association: removal of home advantage is a model assumption, not a calibrated estimate of crowd/travel effects.
